title: Paslen vibe
description: A vibe for the Paslen timer: dial colors, shapes and an optional playlist, pasted into the Vibe editor. Top-level fields are optional: omitted dial settings come from the app theme. The app also accepts // comments and trailing commas, the whole text is limited to 20000 characters, and unknown keys are rejected. Unknown values of shape, icon, iconStyle, fillRule and layout are accepted with a warning and replaced by a fallback; the enums below list the values the app understands.

playlist.description: Link to a playlist in any music service (Spotify, Yandex Music, Deezer...). The editor puts it into the vibe's playlist field.

backdrop.description: One picture on the drum under the digits and ticks, upright, centred on the dial. Takes one of shape, svg or icon; none of them, or svg with icon, is an error. An unknown shape or icon (including line, capsule, wedge and pixel) gives no backdrop and a warning.

shape.description: A figured shape (case, _ and spaces do not matter).

svg.description: SVG path data or an <svg> fragment, as in a tick style.

icon.description: A built-in icon, as in a tick style.

stroke.description: Outline width in drum units; 0 fills the picture.

size.description: Side of the square the picture is fitted into, in diameters of the tick ring.

rotation.description: Clockwise turn around the picture's centre, degrees.

offset.description: Shift [x, y] of the picture's centre, in radii of the tick ring.

color.description: Color of the picture; default colors.dim. A translucent color keeps it in the background.
#RGB, #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB; without alpha the color is opaque.

colorList.description: One color or a list of colors.

background.description: Screen background: one color is solid, a list is a top-to-bottom gradient. Default: theme.

accent.description: Digits and filled ticks. Default: theme onPrimary.

marker.description: Outline of the hollow 12 o'clock mark. Default: the color of that tick.

markerFill.description: Inside of the 12 o'clock mark. Default: top background color.

notch.description: Cross-line in the middle of a tick. Default: markerFill.

shadow.description: Offset colored copy of the digits and ticks (chromatic aberration). Without it there is no shadow.

shadowOffset.description: Offset [x, y] of the digit shadow in dp; needs colors.shadow.

styleName.description: Name of a style from ticks.styles; an unknown name is an error.

tickStyle.description: Look of one tick. Sizes are in the units of the standard dial: its filled tick is 15 wide, its empty tick is 3. A style takes one of shape, icon or svg; svg and icon together are an error.

shape.description: Built-in shape (case, _ and spaces do not matter): flat bar, rounded bar, teardrop, glitchy blocks, or a figured shape drawn like an svg: banana palm leaf (evenodd), pistol round, rifle round, coconut palm frond, palm tree silhouette. Add stroke for an outline.

icon.description: Built-in Phosphor icon instead of shape. The app also accepts PawPrint, paw_print or plural names. Icons drawn diagonally by Phosphor (axe, bone, feather, fish, guitar, key, leaf, pepper, sword) are straightened along the tick.

iconStyle.description: Filled icon or its outlined version (good for empty ticks).

svg.description: Custom shape instead of shape: SVG path data (the d attribute) or a whole <svg> fragment, whose every <path d> is taken with its own origin. Drawn as the tick looks at 12 o'clock, top outwards, fitted into width x length keeping proportions and drawn 1.25 times larger. Path data is limited to 8000 characters and 800 commands.

stroke.description: svg: outline width instead of fill; 0 fills the path.

fillRule.description: svg: fill rule; evenodd cuts holes. fill-rule="evenodd" inside an <svg> fragment turns it on as well.

glowStrength.description: Brightness of the glow: a multiplier of its opacity, 1 is the usual glow. Neon tubes look right at 2-2.5.

core.description: Neon tube: a light core along the tick, as a share of its width, in the tick color lightened towards white. Only line and capsule; others ignore it with a warning.

radial.description: svg, icon or figured shape: true turns it with the ring, top outwards, like a tick; false keeps it upright all around the dial. The primitive line, capsule, wedge and pixel shapes always turn with the ring.

width.description: Width; the standard filled tick is 15, the empty one is 3. Widths above ~24 overlap on a 25-tick ring.

length.description: Multiplier of the standard length (48 units).

notch.description: Cross-line in the middle of the tick; not drawn for svg or icon.

shadowOffset.description: Offset [x, y] of the tick shadow; needs colors.shadow.

major.description: Fixed style of every 5th minute (5, 10, 15, 20 and the full circle at 12 o'clock); it overrides the pattern and random.order. A string sets the same style for the filled and the empty state.

filled.description: Style of a filled 5th minute; if omitted, the pattern decides.

empty.description: Style of an empty 5th minute; if omitted, the pattern decides.

random.description: Repeatable randomness: the same seed always gives the same picture on every device.

order.description: Ticks take pattern styles at random instead of in turn; major stays fixed.

offset.description: Largest shift of a tick from its place on the ring; the sign does not matter. Ring layout only.

rotation.description: Largest tilt of a tick either way, degrees; the sign does not matter.

scale.description: Random size [min, max]; the bounds may come in any order.

ticks.description: Without this section the dial keeps the standard capsules (15 filled, 3 empty).

styles.description: Named tick styles referenced by filled, empty, major and marker.

filled.description: Repeating pattern of filled ticks counted from minute 1: minute i uses item (i - 1) mod length, the 12 o'clock tick is the last minute. An empty list keeps the standard ticks.

marker.description: Style of the hollow 12 o'clock mark; defaults to major.filled, else to the style of that tick.

gradient.description: Color of filled ticks along the arc, counted like the patterns: the first color at minute 1, the last at the 12 o'clock tick (the last minute of the circle); if empty, the accent color. On a light background the gradient runs from light to dark: one that starts dark is turned around.

layout.description: ring: ticks around the drum; scatter: at random spots over the drum, around the digits (case does not matter).
